notes: Tacky is the odd-one-out penguin who saves his friends from hunters by being gloriously odd. Key story beats: the orderly companions vs chaotic Tacky, the hunters arriving and being frightened away by Tacky's antics (loud singing, cannonball splashing, wrong-words marching). 'scared' maps best to Boardmaker 'afraid' icon. 'brave' may need checking — try 'brave' or 'strong'. Existing activity_images (striped shirt, bow tie, snowflake) and aac_extras (different, silly, funny, cold) complement this board well and can be used in classroom extension activities without needing fringe slots.
